name: Saptarshi Debnath
summary: Staff Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and scaling highly-available distributed systems for enterprise and Public Sector environments. Expertise in asynchronous Java, event-driven architectures (Kafka), and leading cross-functional pods to deliver zero-trust, compliance-first infrastructure.

highlights: Architected a FedRAMP High compliant distributed event ingestion pipeline using Java 17 and Kafka, processing 5M+ events per minute with sub-second p99 latency.
Led a team of 8 engineers across 3 time zones to refactor a monolithic legacy authentication service into resilient, bounded contexts, reducing deployment lead time by 40%.
Established technical standards for asynchronous communication patterns, mentoring senior engineers and conducting regular system design reviews.
Migrated key financial transaction logic from synchronous REST to an asynchronous reactive stream model, improving system throughput by 3x during peak load.
Implemented circuit breakers and bulkheads to prevent cascading failures across 15+ microservices.
Reduced cloud infrastructure costs by 20% by optimizing JVM garbage collection tuning and container resource allocation.
